I'd pick **Rossi Idraulica**. It costs less, has twice the warranty and includes taking out the old boiler.

| | Rossi | TermoCasa |
|---|---|---|
| Total incl. VAT | **3,950 EUR** | 4,148 EUR |
| Warranty | 10 yrs (needs a yearly service) | 5 yrs |
| Timing | 2 weeks | Next week |

- **Cost:** Rossi is 198 EUR cheaper. TermoCasa quoted 3,400 EUR plus 22% VAT, which comes to 4,148 EUR. Its quote doesn't mention removing the old boiler.
- **Warranty:** Rossi's 10 years depends on a yearly service. Marta already services your boiler every November, so that costs you nothing extra.
- **Timing:** TermoCasa can fit it a week sooner. You can cover that week by topping up the pressure when it drops.

Before you commit, ask Marta whether replacing just the expansion vessel would fix the pressure drop. Your boiler is only from 2019.
